title: chore(deps): bump lucide-react from 1.28.0 to 1.29.0
body:
Bumps [lucide-react](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/HEAD/packages/lucide-react) from 1.28.0 to 1.29.0.
Release notes

Sourced from lucide-react's releases.

What's Changed

  • feat(docs): remove Super and Noodle from showcase by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4626
  • chore(deps-dev): bump @​angular/platform-server from 21.2.18 to 21.2.19 by @​dependabot[bot] in lucide-icons/lucide#4629

  • feat(dependabot): added dependabot config, grouping PRs for each package by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4633
  • fix(ci): limit certain github workflows to main repository by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4628
  • fix(dependabot): Revert dependabot groups by @​ericfennis in lucide-icons/lucide#4665
  • chore(dependabot): Group by dependency group by @​ericfennis in lucide-icons/lucide#4666
  • chore(deps-dev): bump the svelte-deps group with 3 updates by @​dependabot[bot] in lucide-icons/lucide#4671
  • chore(deps): bump the vue-deps group with 3 updates by @​dependabot[bot] in lucide-icons/lucide#4670
  • chore(deps): bump the github-actions group with 13 updates by @​dependabot[bot] in lucide-icons/lucide#4668
  • feat(icons): added layer reordering icons by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4617
